create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with add_node and add_arc to build a finite state transducer
add_node_to_graph: add a start or final node to a gtn Graph using add_node with boolean flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label using add_arc
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file using gtn.draw with input and output symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single graph using gtn.union
